(2) The scene transitions to a brightly lit indoor medical studio setting where a young male doctor in a white coat and blue shirt sits at a desk equipped with a laptop. A female nurse stands behind him while a young woman and a man in a yellow-striped shirt sit opposite him as patients. The doctor gestures expressively with his hands while speaking with an animated facial expression. (3) A close-up shot focuses on a hand holding a blue pen writing two Chinese names on a white notepad with a small heart symbol drawn between them. (4) The setting remains the clinical office as the doctor continues his enthusiastic interaction with the two visitors, pointing and looking between them. (5) A new graphic title screen appears with yellow and blue text reading 我就是自己的醫生 on a dark background. (6) The man in the striped shirt is now the sole patient, speaking rapidly and pointing to his throat and stomach while the doctor listens with a confused and wide-eyed expression. The nurse watches from the background.
